title: The Priority of Worship
paragraphs: There is nothing more tragic in life than the misuse of time and energy and the wasting of resources. That is tragic. Wasting your time on the wrong thing by doing the wrong thing. I think there is nothing more dangerous than making the means the end. You can become so absorbed in what you do that you forget why you do it. You can, in fact, start worshipping what you do, instead of using what you do to worship God. It is possible. In other words.

The greatest challenge the Creator has for us humans is our preoccupation with the means over the end. You know, when Bahamas Faith Ministries started, we were known for two things. Worship and the Word. Worship was so important to me, from the beginning, from the time of the vision, that I entrusted it to no one. I used to lead the worship myself. And some of you have long been part of this ministry. Some of you have been here for 30 years already.

And when we started with only 30 people, do you remember that I played guitar and led the worship myself? And for more than 10 years, I led the worship myself because worship is the most important thing when we come together. For example, do you know that God said to the children of Israel: "I want you to meet me at a mountain, a certain mountain, and I want you to wash your clothes." He said: "And meet me at 3 o'clock." God gave them a time, 3 hours.

And He said: "Set a barrier around the mountain, and when the people come out of the tents, let them first cleanse their clothes, let them wash their own clothes, and then," He says, "let them worship at 3 o'clock." Why? God planned to descend at exactly 3 o'clock. And the book of Exodus tells us that when they came with their clean clothes and had that barrier around the mountain, so that they could not go any further. It states that at exactly 3 o'clock the presence of the Lord descended upon the mountain.

You know, we start at 9:30 and we have trouble getting people to worship on time. In fact, some people have decided: I will only be there when the teaching starts, and they do not understand that teaching is less important than worship. You have missed the purpose of your visit. Bring your stones, stack them on top of each other, there by your chair, and offer a sacrifice to God. We offer not a lamb, but praise. Now you have missed the most important thing.

The Bible never says that there is joy in the teaching of the Lord, during the teaching of the Lord, and that there are eternal pleasures. It doesn't say that. It says: in the presence of the Lord; you can have good teaching without His presence. His presence is more important than the preacher. And the problem with His presence is that He dwells only in your praise. So if you only arrive at 10:00 because you want to miss worship, you are actually planning not to meet God. Worship.
